what: The logo thumps like a speaker woofer to the beat chart — within one 3.24s bar, at each of six beats (0 · .78 · 1.68 · 1.88 · 2.62 · 3s) it pops up to 1.036x in .032s (power4.out), is pressed down to .982x in .075s (power4.in), then returns to rest in .08s. Each beat has a different strength, so it sounds like musical rhythm

options.beats: Tempo marks ‹time:max/min› separated by commas, default is the original six beats

from.where: index.js hero woofer logo (original Ta: loopSeconds 3.24, six beats of scaleMax/scaleMin/time, starts .6s after opening)
